i_all = np.argmax(y2)
mask_range = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
if np.any(mask_range):
    i_peak = np.where(mask_range)[0][np.argmax(y2[mask_range])]
else:
    i_peak = i_all

# Tangent at peak
slope = np.gradient(y1, x)[i_peak]
y_peak = y1[i_peak]
x_peak = x[i_peak]

# Baseline is horizontal line at weight at 500 C
idx_500 = np.argmin(np.abs(x - 500))
base_y = y1[idx_500]

# Onset calculation:
# Equation of tangent: y = slope * (x - x_peak) + y_peak
# Intersection with base_y: base_y = slope * (x_onset - x_peak) + y_peak
# x_onset = x_peak + (base_y - y_peak) / slope
if abs(slope) > 1e-9:
    x_onset = x_peak + (base_y - y_peak) / slope
else:
    x_onset = x_peak

marks.append({
    'type': 'vline', 
    'x': float(x_onset), 
    'text': f'Onset: {x_onset:.1f} °C',
    'color': 'red',
    'linestyle': 'dashed'
})

# Optional: Draw the baseline segment for visualization if needed, but vline marks the onset.
